# AI 紫微斗數

> AI 驅動的紫微斗數命盤分析系統，採用中州派正統理論結合 GPT-4o 技術，提供繁體中文命理深度解讀。

## 核心服務

- 命盤分析：https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/analysis — 輸入生辰八字即可獲得 AI 深度命盤解讀（免費每月 3 次）
- 定價方案：https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/pricing — 免費（每月 3 次問答）/ NT$199（1 小時無限問答）

## 內容資源

- 部落格：https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/blog — 紫微斗數知識庫，涵蓋十二宮位解析、流日運勢、命理應用

## 關於

- 門派：中州派（傳統紫微斗數正統流派）
- AI 模型：OpenAI GPT-4o
- 語言：繁體中文（主）、英文
- 關於本站：https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/about
- 隱私政策：https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/privacy-policy
- 聯絡：support@aiziwei.online

# AI Zi Wei Dou Shu (English)

> An AI-powered Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology) chart analysis service, built on the Zhongzhou school's classical theory and GPT-4o, with interpretations in Traditional Chinese and English.

## Core services

- Chart analysis: https://aiziwei.online/en/analysis — enter a birth date and time for an AI reading of your chart (free: 3 Q&A per month)
- Pricing: https://aiziwei.online/en/pricing — Free (3 Q&A per month) / NT$199 (1 hour of unlimited Q&A)

## Content

- Blog: https://aiziwei.online/en/blog — Zi Wei Dou Shu knowledge base: the twelve palaces, daily and seasonal fortune, practical applications

## About

- School: Zhongzhou school (a traditional Zi Wei Dou Shu lineage)
- AI model: OpenAI GPT-4o
- Languages: Traditional Chinese (primary), English
- About: https://aiziwei.online/en/about
- Privacy policy: https://aiziwei.online/en/privacy-policy
